behaviour: E2E-80 as a qc contract. scripts/qc/validate-exact-main-regression-ladder.mjs names the three E2E-80 milestones by REGISTERED_GROUPS group name, reads the archived main-proof and archive receipts, and answers whether the staged subset actually ran against one exact main commit. With --rerun it refuses at a head that is not the sha, waits for machine idle, runs the missing groups through the existing ladder runner, and archives the result with the milestone.

nonClaims: The --rerun branch was exercised ONLY through the injected runner command. The pin passes a four-line fake runner that prints '<group>:   1 passed (0.4s)' and a no-op idle wait; Playwright was never launched in this lane and the real ladder runner was never spawned. The real ladder runs in the parent's main proof, and that is the first real exercise of this branch.

Enforcement is PROCEDURAL, by the loop, per the PK-e2e-80-ci-wiring decision. Nothing runs this contract automatically: there is no workflow job and no hook. E2E-80's 'SHALL rerun before the next dependent PR' is satisfied only when the loop actually calls `npm run qc:exact-main-ladder`.

The contract reads RECEIPTS, not runs. It cannot detect a receipt that reports a run that did not happen; it can only refuse to count one it cannot read, one for the wrong commit, one that failed, or one that passed nothing.

The contract reads MISSING at this baseline and at every merge commit in the ledger, because no main-proof receipt has ever run smoke, fixture-smoke or membership-smoke (admission finding F3). This unit does not create that coverage and does not claim it.

SPEC_BY_GROUP is not consulted. It is not exported (finding F1) and the charter forbids changing the core module, so the ladder names group NAMES read from REGISTERED_GROUPS. The evolving smoke subset still grows only inside buildRunPlan; the contract never lists spec files, so it cannot go stale against that growth - but it also cannot verify that the subset contains what a milestone expects.

No build ran. No Playwright ran. No npm install, ci, prune or lifecycle ran anywhere (npm_config_dry_run=true was exported in every shell). Nothing was committed, pushed, stashed, amended or force-pushed, and the root checkout at E:/Projects/MekStation was not touched (verified at the end: `git -C E:/Projects/MekStation status --short` printed nothing and HEAD is still fd71b9d7cd6579b1db7fe62995e4436318f0df67).
scripts/qc/gm-two-player-campaign-core.cjs and scripts/qc/run-gm-two-player-campaign.mjs were READ and consumed, never modified.

The default archive dir is gitignored (finding F2), so an archive receipt written by --rerun does not reach main on its own. The CLI reads the evidence dir as well, so a copied receipt counts; making that copy is the loop's job and is not implemented here.

deviationsFromTheCharter: The charter's sketch says a group is covered by a receipt 'whose verdict is PASS'. A main-proof receipt is held to exactly that. This contract's OWN archive receipt carries verdict SATISFIED / MISSING (the charter's own shape for it in item 4), so a literal PASS-only rule would have made every archive receipt worthless the moment it was written and a check-mode run right after a successful --rerun would have reported MISSING. The shipped rule holds each shape to its own passing word: a receipt with a `groups` array must say SATISFIED, any other must say PASS. Three pin cases cover it (an archive receipt on the exact sha is coverage; an archive receipt saying MISSING is not; an archive receipt wearing the main-proof word PASS is not), and the charter's stated case - 'MISSING when the receipt verdict is not PASS' - is pinned with a main-proof receipt marked FAIL, unchanged.

`idleWait` is injectable alongside `runnerCommand`. The charter names only `runnerCommand` as injectable, but the rerun-branch case would otherwise have had to await the real machine-idle wait, which enumerates live processes and would make the pin depend on whatever else the machine is running. Both are plain function options with real defaults (the real ladder runner, the real U11 waitForIdle) and NEITHER is reachable from the CLI: there is no flag that skips the idle wait, so 'no silent idle' holds.
